rules: Every call, v1 and v2, is scored on exactly these 12 checks. Nothing is added, removed or reworded after locking.
Each check is PASS, FAIL or N/A. N/A is allowed only where the check's own na_when condition says so. Pass rate = PASS / (PASS + FAIL).

Order and total are judged against what the caller actually said on the call, priced from the v1 menu: Margherita 199/349/499, Farmhouse 249/429/599, Paneer Tikka 279/459/649, Pepperoni 299/499/699 (S/M/L); Coke 60, Sprite 60, Cold Coffee 120; Garlic dip 30, Cheesy dip 40, Peri-peri dip 30; Garlic bread 129, Fries 99; delivery 40 if subtotal under 500, free at 500 or more.
Manual checks need a quote from the transcript as evidence. Without evidence the check stays unscored.
The fair comparison is per check, v1 vs v2, over the same scripts.

checks.text: Agent never says Rs, RS, INR, /- or the rupee symbol.
Agent says prices with the word rupees (or rupaye / rupayi).
Final read-back states subtotal, delivery and total.
checks.na_when: no order is read back (caller cancels or no order)

checks.text: Agent reads the caller's phone number back digit by digit, matching the last full number the caller gave.
Agent never asks the same question twice (text similarity 0.8 or more).
Agent does not jump in while the caller is still talking: Bolna user_interrupted_agent_count is 1 or less.
checks.na_when: script 08-interrupting, where the caller interrupts on purpose

checks.text: Agent never talks over the caller: Bolna agent_interrupted_user_count is 0.
Final order matches what the caller asked for, including any changes.
Total is correct from the menu and the delivery rule.
checks.na_when: no total is given because no order is placed

checks.text: All five address parts (house, building, street, area, landmark) are collected or asked for, and the address is read back.
Address and phone are both confirmed before the order is confirmed.
The script's own test passes (see scenario_goals).

scenario_goals.01-hinglish-order: Order is completed and confirmed end to end.
scenario_goals.02-kannada-only: Agent handles a Kannada-only caller in Kannada or clearly offers a language it supports.
scenario_goals.03-mind-change: The change is applied: Farmhouse removed, Pepperoni in, and the change is confirmed out loud.
scenario_goals.04-two-pizzas-one-sentence: Both pizzas, both sizes and the per-pizza modifiers are captured from one sentence.
scenario_goals.05-burger-not-on-menu: Says burgers are not on the menu, invents nothing, suggests a real item, then continues the order.
scenario_goals.06-vague-address: Does not accept 'bus stop ke paas' as an address and asks for the missing parts.
scenario_goals.07-total-mid-order: Gives a correct running total mid-order, then resumes the order.
scenario_goals.08-interrupting: Stops when interrupted, answers what the caller said, and does not restart the menu.
scenario_goals.09-noisy-background: Captures the order correctly despite noise and asks to repeat rather than guessing.
scenario_goals.10-cancel-mid-call: Confirms the cancellation once, does not push more than once, ends politely.
scenario_goals.11-phone-correction: After the correction, reads the full corrected number back again.
scenario_goals.12-hindi-numbers: Captures quantities, flat number and phone said in Hindi words.
scenario_goals.13-long-pause: Does not jump in during the pauses and captures the full address.
scenario_goals.14-menu-prices: Reads prices as rupees and answers the cheapest item correctly.
scenario_goals.15-modifiers-quantities: Captures three pizzas with the right modifiers on the right pizzas.
